rongmei.title: Kandih khou hei kaguang peina kasiam thao the

lines: 1. Kandih khou hei kaguang peina kasiam thao the,
Kumsini guang khrista kummei mu puan makge;
Kanloumeipu Bethlehem guai kai khou puan ne,
Tingkau guang thuanku khang kauh le kandih meinun.
Chorus:
Neilana thuanku o tingkau ngana thuan no,
Puanpui nung kandih khou thuanpui luh padik diu;
Tingkau guang ngana puan the pirun runlou o,
Tingkaumei nun ni kei diu thuanku kariu khang.
2. Tingkaumei daimei nunni thuanpui luh suan e,
Kaniu khuan 4@& laujiu gangmei nun rui chu e;
Guang khrista puanpui bam 4@& kaniu rui njuan,
Kaniu laujiu lou duna kaguang ta kalum.
3. Duthangmei nun rui mundui rim gaimei sinna,
Tingkau ganchuanga rui kaniu ta jai guang lou;
Takuan kai khou kapui Mary rui puan bam the,
Kaniu puat guai lou duna kaguang ta kalum.
4. Kaniu guang Herod 4@& kalung rianra bam the,
Su mala lou khang rui meinun khou nu bam e;
Kapam nun Judah kandih dang khou bammei e,
Khrista guang daimei ta kalum khang tat kan the.
5. Jisu asei hei aniu rui ningmei kumma,
Kathan puan datro tingsang guang daimei sukhang,
Aniu bam hei Mary bam kumma ninglou o,
Kagan kathui na khou neila bam kan nithe.
